clues: This town is in Haryana state in India. It lies near the banks of the Yamuna River.
Monsoon rain here is far above the state average. It falls at more than twice that average rate.
Before 1947, this town was a royal capital. It was the capital of the princely state of Kalsia.
People often give this town a rainy nickname. They call it the Cherapunjii of its state.
A low part of town is called Khadar. It sits near the banks of the Yamuna River.
